figurative_meaning_en: eternally; from time immemorial; forever; boundlessly
example_sentences_in_bangla: এই বিতর্ক অ্যাড ইনফিনিটাম চলতে পারে।
example_sentences_in_english: This debate can go on ad infinitum.
Their friendship is ad infinitum lasting.
note: This is a transliteration of the Latin phrase 'ad infinitum', commonly used in educated or formal Bengali contexts.
